messages:
aks: Quick sync 10: we're launching an opt-in 'route metadata' attribution in Console tomorrow. Need to align SDK surface and console snippet.

nina: What's the proposed contract? header or body?

aks: Header for now: x-rd-route-meta. JSON payload, small keys: route_id, intent, prefer_route_sampling. Opt-in only.

ryan: If it's a header we must enforce size <= 2048 bytes at edge. Proxies sometimes drop long headers. We'll emit metric route_meta_too_big.

nina: SDK implications: Python/TS currently accept headers as dict->string conversion which will mangle nested JSON. We should ship small helpers to safely set the header and validate size.

aks: Suggested helper names: py: client.set_route_meta(...); ts: client.routeMeta.set(...); go: WithRouteMeta(ctx, meta). Keep them non-breaking (minor releases).

devops-bot: deploy scheduled 07:00-09:00 UTC. Canary in org:internal. Monitor: route_meta_parse_errors and route_meta_too_big.

ryan: Also add support for a b64 fallback in the snippet for legacy proxies: prefix value with b64:. SDK helper should accept raw dict or b64 string and handle transparently.

nina: Tests: unit for encoding/size validation + e2e that checks header arrives to telemetry pipeline and console groups by route_id. Also docs snippet showing raw header and helper usage.

aks: UX: Console banner will show one-click snippet. If SDK helper isn't present we show raw header example and call out helper availability. We'll keep header opt-in and announce deprecation plan if ever requiring it.

ryan: One more: telemetry wants optional sampling flag prefer_route_sampling true/false in the same payload.

nina: I'll open PRs for py/ts/go today. Tagging @ryan for review and @aks for sign-off.

aks: Thanks. If PRs land, we'll update the banner to use helper snippet.

devops-bot: Canary deployed. Keep an eye on metrics.
